divergences.description: In the lazy session-creation path, _onMessageSubmitted now emits an extra ChatReady with the new sessionId right after creating the session. No task asks for this. It changes RF04's existing emission sequence, and an existing RF04 test's expected states were edited to match.

Spec FR-003 and US1 scenario 3 say that while a message sits in the error state awaiting retry, the insight attempt must be deferred. The implementation calls _onTurnResolved straight from _failTurn and at the end of _consumeTurn, including when the turn failed. A pending insight is therefore attempted while the failed message is still waiting for a retry. Tasks T015/T016 call for this wiring, so the tasks and the spec contradict each other.

T038 requires a widget test showing that tapping dismiss removes only the card while the scroll offset and the other message widgets stay unchanged. The test that was added only checks that InsightDismissed is dispatched. It never checks the scroll offset or that the card is removed.

T022 requires a test that the card renders at anchorIndex with the surrounding messages shifted. The test puts anchorIndex at the end of the list (3, with 3 messages), so it never checks a card placed between messages or the index shifting. It also never checks the scroll position.

T039 requires checking that no card survives reopening via _onConversationSelected, _onNewConversationRequested, and a fresh ChatBloc instance (app restart). The test that was added only covers ConversationSelected.
